rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese noun for rising prices and declining purchasing power.

example.english: The inflation has gotten so bad that even the cha chaan teng we usually eat at has raised its prices.
example.traditional: 最近通脹太勁，連平時食開嘅茶餐廳都加價。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 tung1 zoeng3 taai3 ging6 lin4 ping4 si4 sik6 hoi1 ge3 caa4 caan1 teng1 dou1 gaa1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for the act of putting air or another gas into something, rather than for the resulting swelling.

example.english: The float needs inflation before we go to the beach.
example.traditional: 去沙灘前，要先幫個水泡充氣。
example.jyutping: heoi3 saa1 taan1 cin4 jiu3 sin1 bong1 go3 seoi2 paau1 cung1 hei3

rows.note: Use this for the resulting physical expansion or swelling, rather than the act of filling something with air.

example.english: The inflation of the plastic bottle in the sun nearly made it burst.
example.traditional: 個膠樽畀太陽曬到膨脹，差啲爆咗。
example.jyutping: go3 gaau1 zeon1 bei2 taai3 joeng4 saai3 dou3 paang4 zoeng3 caa1 di1 baau3 zo2
